description: Different model profiles should preserve SwiftPM/XCTest planning decisions, including parser extension, async service coverage, and UI/DTO deferral.

lockedFields.reason: SwiftPM plans must preserve the repo-native Swift test command.
The async PaymentClient service should become one add-test item.
The existing CheckoutParser test should be extended for missing edge cases.
The DTO and SwiftUI view should remain deferred from direct testing.
Covered risky Swift parser logic should keep a stable extend-test item id.
The adapter must preserve matching XCTest evidence.
The plan must preserve the proven Swift declaration relationship rather than downgrade it to filename evidence.
Module-qualified Swift symbol evidence should retain referenced strength.
CheckoutParser construction should remain recorded as called usage.
Untested async service code should stay a direct unit-test candidate.
SwiftUI views should stay deferred without an existing UI or snapshot convention.
